description: Composes a dyadic rule-dispute's issue severity, relationship closeness (band_code/tie_strength, reusing bigville's already-built plumbing verbatim -- commit 1b79a0f), and bystander/witness count into a scalar 'pressure', classified via Argmin nearest-point decode against a 2-entry DisputeOutcomeAnchor codebook (defuse/escalate) -- the SAME compose-then-Argmin-classify shape seeds/can_register_quantization.json already established, reused here rather than reinvented (RULE_DISPUTE_ESCALATION_PREREG.md Sec1's own SHAPES-not-numbers justification). The load-bearing design choice is the (1-closeness) interaction term: audience presence amplifies escalation (Felson 1982, 'Impression Management and the Escalation of Aggression and Violence'), but closeness SUPPRESSES that amplification rather than merely offsetting it additively (Coleman, Deutsch & Marcus, Handbook of Conflict Resolution -- established cooperative-norm relationships actively resist destructive escalation) -- the same interaction-effect shape Giles' Communication Accommodation Theory already gave this session's register/style work (convergence in-group, divergence out-group). Zero new Rust Terms -- Div/Times/Minus/Plus/Abs/Let/Argmin/Attr/Var/Lit/Eq/And all pre-existed. See RULE_DISPUTE_ESCALATION_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md.

concepts.name: rule_dispute_escalation
concepts.definition: A tabletop rules disagreement's outcome (defuse or escalate into an argument) is a scalar composition of issue severity, dyadic closeness, and audience size, classified via Argmin nearest-point decode against a held 2-entry outcome codebook -- the register-quantization rung's compose-then-classify shape, applied to a conflict-pressure quantity instead of a communication-style quantity.
concepts.why: The user asked for a testable scenario where two Bigville board-game residents disagree about a rule, and the disagreement either defuses or escalates depending on the nature of the issue, the two people, and who else is in the room -- RULE_DISPUTE_ESCALATION_PREREG.md.

rules.name: rd_decide_outcome
rules.comment: PREREG Sec2: composes a scalar 'pressure' from issue_severity (how starkly a claim contradicts the resident's own document-grounded HeldRule reading), closeness (band_code/5.0, reusing bigville's already-built band_code/tie_strength plumbing verbatim -- bigville commit 1b79a0f), and witnesses (bystander count, a bare integer -- who else is in the room), then classifies against a 2-entry DisputeOutcomeAnchor codebook (defuse/escalate) via Argmin nearest-point decode -- the SAME compose-then-Argmin-classify shape can_register_decode_band already established (seeds/can_register_quantization.json), reused here for a different composed quantity. ALL arithmetic (Div/Times/Minus/Plus/Abs/Let/Argmin/Attr/Var/Lit/Eq/And) is pre-existing Term vocabulary -- zero new Rust. The escalate-vs-defuse DECISION is this Rule's own Argmin call, not Python.
